source_name: ARBK e-services / e-registration portal (rbk.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: The transactional front-end where registration and CHANGE requests are filed — change of owner, change of authorised representative/director, statute and capital changes. It is where organisation-change events originate before they surface in any extract; understanding its request taxonomy tells us exactly which change types exist and are recordable.

source_name: ARBK API / Bizneset Kosovë (applifyer)
why_relevant: A commercial API wrapper over Kosovo business registry data; if it exposes officer/representative fields it becomes the cheapest programmatic route to detect director changes across a watchlist.

source_name: Regjistri i Pengut (ARBK pledge / security-interests register)
why_relevant: The pledge register run alongside ARBK records secured-creditor filings. Filings name the financial institution and the officer/representative signing on its behalf, and reveal which banks/PSPs are active with which counterparties — an indirect but legally mandated trace of who is authorised to act for an institution.

source_name: RQLL — Regjistri Qendror i Lejeve dhe Licencave (Central Registry of Permits and Licences)
why_relevant: Public electronic registry, run by the Office of the Prime Minister under Law 04/L-202, of every permit/licence issued by central institutions, including financial-sector authorisations and registration of authorised representatives. Enumerates which authority issues what, revealing further registers and licence-holder lists to track.

source_name: Gjykata Komerciale e Kosovës (Commercial Court) — decisions and case register
why_relevant: Established by Law 08/L-015, the Commercial Court hears company, commercial and registration disputes — including challenges to registry entries, shareholder disputes and director removals. Its published decisions name officers and expose organisation changes that are contested rather than merely filed.

source_name: OCCRP Aleph — Kosovo Business Registration Agency dataset
why_relevant: A structured, searchable copy of the Kosovo companies register inside Aleph, cross-linkable with other jurisdictions' registers and leaks. Useful for person-centric queries (find all Kosovo entities where a given bank executive appears) that the native ARBK portal does not support.

source_name: OpenCorporates — Kosovo Business Registration Agency register profile
why_relevant: Documents the Kosovo register's openness profile: freely searchable but scoring 15/100 on the Open Company Data Index, with officers, directors, shareholders and accounts recorded as NOT available in bulk/open form. Critical for calibrating expectations and for justifying reliance on per-entity extracts rather than open data.

source_name: Commercial registry-extract providers for Kosovo (Schmidt & Schmidt, Creditreform, theKYB, businessdataguide)
source_subtype: commercial extract broker / KYB data vendor
why_relevant: Paid intermediaries that obtain official ARBK extracts (current and historical) in Albanian or English, including officer and shareholder detail. They are the practical fallback when a legally-defensible, dated extract of a director change is needed and self-service search is insufficient; their product pages also document exactly which fields the official extract contains.

source_name: ARBK Atlas (arbk.atlas-studio.eu) — third-party Kosovo business registry front-end
why_relevant: Another independent front-end advertising 240,000+ Kosovo companies; alternative access route and possible field coverage differences (e.g. officer names) versus arbk.org. Redundancy matters because the official portal is the single point of failure for this cell.

source_name: Open Data Kosovo — Open Businesses
why_relevant: Civil-society open-data project built on the ARBK register; a route to historical bulk snapshots and to the people/organisations who have already solved Kosovo registry parsing. Pointer to further datasets and to the state of registry openness.

source_name: e-Prokurimi — Kosovo public e-procurement platform (contract award notices)
why_relevant: Publishes contract and award notices trilingually (sq/sr/en), including those of BQK itself and of public bodies buying banking/payment services. Award notices name winning supplier companies, which can then be resolved in ARBK to their directors and owners — a systematic way to discover the vendor population around banks and PSPs.

source_name: Këshilla Ligjore — guides to finding Kosovo business information / Commercial Court
why_relevant: Albanian-language practitioner guides that enumerate which Kosovo registers exist and how to obtain company information, including officer data — a compact local-language map of the registry landscape that surfaces portals not visible in English search.

source_name: Kosovska Agencija za Registraciju Preduzeća (Serbian-language ARBK presentation via cps.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: Confirms the registry's Serbian-language official name and that ARBK registers all business organisations and foreign business organisations. Establishes the sr-language terminology needed to search for the same filings and to cover Serbian-language reporting on Kosovo bank leadership.

source_name: KRPP / Komisioni Rregullativ i Prokurimit Publik (Public Procurement Regulatory Commission)
why_relevant: Regulator that operates e-Prokurimi, maintains the authoritative list of contracting authorities and publishes annual public-procurement reports. The contracting-authority list is the master actor map for which public financial bodies must tender; the annual reports aggregate contract volumes and top suppliers — a pointer into supplier names and institutional structure.

source_name: AQP / Agjencia Qendrore e Prokurimit (Central Procurement Agency)
why_relevant: Runs centralised/framework procurements on behalf of central institutions, including cross-government service contracts. Framework contracts for banking, card and payment-related services would be awarded here rather than by an individual ministry, so it is the place where a single supplier win covers many public bodies.

source_name: OSHP / Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit (Procurement Review Body)
why_relevant: Publishes binding decisions on bidder complaints. Decisions narrate who bid, who lost and why — an unusually rich, adversarial disclosure of the payments/IT supplier field around public financial institutions, including technical and staffing qualification disputes. Also publishes a blacklist of excluded operators.

source_name: OSHP decisions mirror — oshp.dplus.org (civil-society searchable database)
why_relevant: A third-party structured/searchable mirror of Procurement Review Body decisions, typically far easier to query than the official site. Useful as a fallback and for bulk keyword search across years of decisions.

source_name: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve (MFPT) — official site
why_relevant: The ministry that owns Treasury, tax and public financial management. Publishes vacancy notices (konkurse), procurement notices, organigram/structure changes and senior appointments. Its Treasury department is the counterparty for government payment/banking arrangements, so its staffing and reorganisations are leading indicators of public payment-system change.

source_name: FSDK / Fondi i Sigurimit të Depozitave në Kosovë — Job Vacancies
why_relevant: The Deposit Insurance Fund publishes its own vacancy notices (e.g. Zyrtar i Lartë i Kompensimit) — direct evidence of headcount and of which functions (payout/compensation, IT, risk) it is building out, which in turn signals bank-resolution readiness work.

source_name: FSDK — Procurement / tender announcements
why_relevant: FSDK publishes its own public tenders (e.g. external audit, IT/payout systems). Payout-system and IT tenders identify vendors positioned in deposit-insurance and bank-resolution infrastructure.

source_name: FSDK — Management Board and Team pages
why_relevant: Roster of the Fund's board and senior staff. Diffing these pages over time is the cheapest reliable detector of leadership moves and org changes at the Deposit Insurance Fund.

source_name: KCGF / Fondi Kosovar për Garanci Kreditore — Mundësi punësimi (careers)
why_relevant: KCGF hires specialists whose titles map directly onto its risk appetite and product direction (ESG Specialist, Claim and Recovery Specialist, apprentices). Vacancy flow is a direct read on the guarantee fund's expansion and on which partner-bank-facing functions it is scaling.

source_name: KCGF — Bordi / Struktura organizative / Personeli
why_relevant: Published org chart, board list and staff list. Direct, dateable evidence of organisational change and leadership turnover at a state-backed credit guarantee institution that sits between the Ministry of Finance and the commercial banks.

source_name: KCGF — Mundësi partneriteti (tenders / calls for proposals)
why_relevant: KCGF issues calls for suppliers and partners (e.g. website + credit-guarantee eligibility tool development). These reveal its technology vendors and digital-channel roadmap, and often specify required personnel profiles.

source_name: BQK / Central Bank of Kosovo — procurement notices (wp-content PDF store)
why_relevant: BQK is both regulator and a public financial institution that tenders payments infrastructure. Award notices published on its site name suppliers directly — e.g. a 2026 contract award notice for 'TIPS Clone Connectivity Services' (instant-payments infrastructure) and a group life insurance award to Illyria Life. This is the single richest public route to Kosovo's national payment-system vendor landscape.

source_name: Trusti / Fondi i Kursimeve Pensionale i Kosovës — konkurse and procurement PDFs
why_relevant: Kosovo's mandatory pension fund is a major public financial institution and a subject of the Public Procurement Law. It publishes vacancy notices (e.g. Zyrtar i Sigurisë së TI — IT security officer) and board competitions as dated PDFs, and procures payments/IT services. Direct signal on public-sector fintech/IT hiring and on board-level appointments.

source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — Assembly board-appointment competitions and procurement directorate
why_relevant: The Assembly runs the public competitions for and votes on board members of the Central Bank and other independent financial institutions — the formal channel through which top-level leadership of Kosovo's financial supervisory architecture changes. It also has its own procurement directorate publishing notices.
